opening.argument: The material presents Fintoch as an opportunity to lend cryptocurrency for a stated 1% daily return, while showing an investment screen with “Daily Yield 1%” and instructing viewers how to locate BNB in the app. It then solicits participation by inviting viewers to join an investor and business-builder team and contact the speaker. The withdrawal screen displays an extractable USDT amount subject to a matching-pool service fee, reinforcing the appearance of accessible returns. These features establish promotional investment solicitation, although the material does not establish a completed withdrawal, victim loss, or that the stated returns were received. Its acknowledgment that “nothing can be guaranteed” and that there are “uncertainty and risks” does not remove the central return-based pitch.

citations.quote: if you actually loaned out a crypto currency like BNB, to generate the 1% profit per day, how do you check your income?
Only if you are sincere to join my team of investors and business builders then connect with me and I will guide you how.
As you know nothing can be guaranteed in this world, so in all that we do, there will be certain level of uncertainty and risks.
